mapper.select: SELECT pt.* FROM dbo.PrepOrderDetail AS pod INNER JOIN dbo.PrepOrder AS po ON pod.orderId = po.id INNER JOIN dbo.ProdOrder AS prd ON po.erpOrderNo = prd.erpOrderNo AND pod.inventoryCode = prd.inventoryCode INNER JOIN dbo.v_stockTag AS pt ON prd.id = pt.prodOrderId WHERE pod.orderId = #{prepId}
